definitions.explanation: Something that gives one motivation or encouragement to continue efforts.

examples.japanese: みんなの{応援|おうえん}が{励|はげ}みになる。
{子供|こども}の{笑顔|えがお}が{仕事|しごと}の{励|はげ}みだ。
examples.english: My children's smiles are my motivation at work.

examples.japanese: {励|はげ}みになる{言葉|ことば}をありがとう。
examples.english: Thank you for the encouraging words.

notes:
RELATED VERB:
{励|はげ}む - to work hard, to strive
{励|はげ}ます - to encourage (someone)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{励|はげ}みになる - to be encouraging/motivating
・{励|はげ}みを{与|あた}える - to give encouragement
・{大|おお}きな{励|はげ}み - great encouragement

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{張|は}り{合|あ}い - stimulation, motivation (from competition)
・やりがい - sense of fulfillment
・{動機|どうき} - motive

NUANCE:
{励|はげ}み emphasizes the encouragement aspect, giving someone strength to continue.
